questions.question: What percentage of adults worldwide drink coffee daily?
questions.answer: 65% - About two-thirds of adults drink coffee every day.

questions.question: On average, how many cups of coffee do Americans drink per day?
questions.answer: 3 - The average coffee drinker in the U.S. consumes about 3 cups daily.

questions.question: True or False: Coffee is the second most traded commodity in the world after oil.
questions.answer: True - Coffee is one of the most traded global commodities.

questions.question: Which of these drinks contains the most caffeine?
questions.answer: Drip Coffee - A full cup of drip coffee usually contains more caffeine than a single shot of espresso.

questions.question: True or False: Instant coffee has more caffeine than freshly brewed coffee.
questions.answer: False - Instant coffee typically contains less caffeine than brewed coffee.

questions.question: Which country is the largest producer of coffee in the world?
questions.answer: Brazil - Brazil has been the largest coffee producer for over 150 years.

questions.question: True or False: Drinking coffee can improve alertness and concentration.
questions.answer: True - Caffeine stimulates the nervous system, boosting focus and energy.

questions.question: Which of these is a traditional method of brewing coffee?
questions.answer: French Press - A popular brewing method that uses immersion and a plunger.

questions.question: True or False: Coffee always causes dehydration.
questions.answer: False - While coffee is mildly diuretic, moderate consumption does not dehydrate you.

questions.question: Which of these best describes the role of coffee in many cultures?
options: A social ritual and daily habit
questions.answer: A social ritual and daily habit - Coffee brings people together and is part of daily routines worldwide.
